name: word-roller-split-flap
title: Word Roller Split Flap
description: An airport-style departure board where each word flips onto a row of flap tiles, letter by letter, through a list of places before it lands on a final word; a status line changes from searching to confirmed.
useWhen: A list of options (cities, offers, names) that cycles on a physical board and lands on a final word.
A mechanical feel for a destination, price or status reveal.
avoidWhen: A caption that should flip letters in time with speech: use caption-split-flap.
Very long words: each letter is a tile.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas (up to 10). The last one is where it settles.
variables.default: PARIS, LONDON, TOKYO, NEW YORK, SYDNEY, BERLIN, WELCOME

variables.label: Label
variables.description: Small caps line above the board.

variables.label: Status while flipping
variables.description: Text under the board before the last word.

variables.label: Status at the end
variables.description: Text under the board once the last word is shown.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the letters in pixels. The board shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Status dot
variables.description: Color of the status dot at the end.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
